scene1.heading: Raksha Bandhan
scene1.sub:
Ek rishta jo sirf reshmi dhaage se nahi,
saalon ke pyaar, vishwas aur
ankahi meethhi yaadon se bandha hai.

scene2.sub:
Har dhaage mein chhupi ek paavan dua,
har rang mein simta ek meetha vaada,
jo waqt ke saath aur bhi gehra hota jaaye.

scene3.sub:
Bachpan ki befikr shararatein, woh nanhi nok-jhok,
aur ta-umar saath nibhane ka sabse pyara vaada.
Aapko Raksha Bandhan ki dil se shubhkamnayein!

scene4.desc:
Har purani tasveer mein muskurati hai hamari bachpan ki khushiyan,
aur har panna bayan karta hai hamari ek anmol kahani.

scene5.heading: Timeline of Us
memoryDescs: Wahi meetha bandhan, aur bhi gehra

scene6.quote:
Rishtey toh kayi hote hain duniya mein,
par bhai-behen ka ye rishta sabse khas hai...
jisme thodi si ladai hai, behisaab pyaar hai,
aur ta-umar saath rehne ka meetha ehsaas hai.

scene6b.heading:
A Little Something
From My Heart
scene6b.note:
Chhahe kitni bhi dooriyan ho ya kitni bhi nok-jhok,
tum hamesha meri sabse badi taaqat aur khushi ki wajah rahoge.

scene7.heading: Happy Raksha Bandhan
scene7.wishes:
Hamesha khush raho, muskuraate raho,
duniya ki saari khushiyan aur safalta tumhein mile.
Aankhon mein vishwas aur dil mein aprampar pyaar rahe.
